lines.en: I do not really walk about
I have stood here a long while
I have only shifted two steps
I know this floor well
I peek out from behind the pillar
I drift over to the steps
My steps make almost no sound
I move aside to the doorway
I circle the desk half a turn
I return to my own spot
I pass beneath the window
I never leave this building
I stop under the eaves
I edge quietly to the table
I stand and wait for someone
The room is quiet, I listen
I tuck my hands in my sleeves
I am thinking of my next line
I look up at the rafters
I wait for someone to speak
There is nothing else for me
I count the window panes
I watch the doorway
I have no intention of leaving
I hum once, softly
I smooth the hem of my robe
I have stood so long I feel stiff
I lift my eyes and lower them
Are you here to talk to me
Right-click and we can speak
You are the sort I wait for
You come with a task, I think
I still have work to hand you
You look down at me, so tall
I have words for you
Hear me out first
I carry no weapon
Do not expect me to fight
Are you asking the way or the task
Let me say this up front
You may come closer
My answer is only a few lines
I duck and cover my head
I back all the way to the wall
The pain takes my words
This is not mine to bear
I steady myself on the table
The hem of my robe is torn
The pain takes my voice
All I can do is take hits
I had not finished speaking
I shrink my shoulders
I never eat anything
Put that away
I take quest items only
Food does not help the task
You offer me this and ask
I shake my head, useless
What I want is your errand
That breaks the rules here
Come back with the right thing
I take no such thing here
You nearly bowled me over
I step aside for you
My sleeve is tugged along
I cannot quite keep my feet
Walk a little slower
You push me to the wall
I put a hand up
That is no real injury
I return to my old spot
This room has no companion for me
I am alone in this room
I wait for someone to ask
My work is not finished
I have not thought of such things
My mind is on the task
I am glad when someone comes
I wish someone would stay
This room is too empty
I see him to the door
I pick up a fallen note
This is needed for the task
I tuck it into my sleeve
I take up a copper coin
I will keep this
I set it back on the shelf
I count them and put them back
This is meant for a visitor
I keep it safe
You came, good
I have my words ready
The task goes to you now
Listen until I finish
This trip is yours to make
Let me state the terms
Will you agree or not
I wait on your answer
Do not rush off yet
I have an errand for you
You have not answered me
I will say it a second time
You are heading the wrong way
I wait here for your reply
What you seek is not there
The place I named is elsewhere
Come back and I will explain
The task will not finish itself
I remember your name
What you brought is not enough
I never so much as raise a hand
I raise a hand only to block
I step back, no blow
My strength is very small
Do not make me swing at you
I am only a messenger
I will go call someone for you
I turn and shut the door
I duck behind the table
This is not my work
I was placed in this room
The building keeps me here
I come out from the pillar
A figure appears at the desk
The lamp finds my face
The door opens and I am there
I appear inside the structure
This room needs me
I take my own place
The flame heats my face
The fall hurts badly
Water closes over my head
The blast throws me into the corner
An arrow grazes my arm
Magic light strikes my body
I eat very little anyway
The thunder makes me jump
I keep falling down
